## Iris Murdoch on morality

Iris Murdoch (1919–1999) approaches morality within moral philosophy. Moral philosophy needs a realistic idea of the Good beyond will and choice alone. Egoism clouds vision; love and art can purify attention toward particular realities. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets morality most directly—useful for searches such as “iris murdoch quotes on morality.”

## How to use this page
